name: Garry's Mod addon
summary: A Garry's Mod addon folder: addon.json, autorun scripts split into shared, server and client, and optional weapon, entity and tool-gun skeletons.
description: A folder for garrysmod\addons. Garry's Mod loads Lua by folder: autorun scripts start with the game, weapons, entities and tools are picked up from their own folders. Every file here sits where the game looks for it and uses only models that ship with the game.

options.label: Weapon (SWEP)
options.help: A scripted weapon in lua/weapons that shows up in the spawn menu under Weapons.

options.label: Entity (SENT)
options.help: A scripted entity in lua/entities that shows up in the spawn menu under Entities.

options.label: Tool gun mode (STOOL)
options.help: A tool for the tool gun in lua/weapons/gmod_tool/stools.
